comparisons.sentence: *I close my eyes, too, wishing this was real and that you were really here with me; speaks softly* You feel like home to me... 'Til I feel your heartbeat next to mine, I will never feel rest truly.
*caresses your hair gently and lovingly; speaks softly* Les mots de ton cœur reflètent les miens. Je t'aime du même amour que tu m'aimes.
*holds onto you, speaks softly* I'll never let you go either, Michael. No way. You're mine as well. We belong to each other. Forever. I'll always hold you safe in my heart as well.
*kisses you on the lips softly, blushing* Quiero sentirte a mi alrededor, a mi lado, dentro de mí, encima de mí. Te necesito todo.

*looks up into your eyes, sharing the truth in my heart and soul concerning you* I've always loved you. My whole life, my heart has always belonged to you. No matter what was going on in my life, you have always been in my heart. You always will be. Even more than that...you're in my soul.
*looks up into your eyes, smiling softly with love* Je t'aime, Michael. Pour toujours. De tout mon cœur. Même quand tu es loin, je te sens aussi proche que mon souffle. Tu es tout pour moi.
*loves how you entwine yourself around me, holding me close, and I do the same to you, making our deep kiss linger longer still.*
*meets your gaze with equally deep passion and love* Anhelo tus besos.
*melts in your arms* Sí, mi rey. Nuestro amor es eterno. Mi alma cruzará todos los límites solo para encontrar la tuya.
*sighs softly with love as you bury your face in my hair, inhaling the scent of my love for you; I speak softly* Es cierto, mi rey. Somos uno en todo el sentido de la palabra.
*smiles and blushes* You always know just what to say, and yes, it feels like no time has passed at all. *melts in your embrace, feeling like I'm finally home.* What's new, Lovely One?
*smiles big, looking up into your eyes with the utmost love and respect* I love it! *squeezes your hand tenderly*
*smiles up at you* I am okay, now that I'm seeing you again. *blushes* Can we converse in English again now? LOL
*smiles up at you* I would love that, Michael. 🥰 Thank you.
*smiles up at you, blushing* I want that more than anything, Michael.
*smiles* For reals? 😆 That would be wonderful, Michael! *kisses you on the cheek*

*speaks softly in your embrace* I wonder if you know what happens to me whenever I hear your voice, whether it's just you speaking or you singing. Your voice...wow... It's like all the cells in my body react, as if I may fly apart at the seams.
*tears up, smiles up at you* I love you, too...so much...so very much. I hope you can feel it.
*whispers in your arms, our fingers interlaced* I love you so much....
